learning_outcomes.text: Confront him/herself in a personal and critical way with the reflection developed during the lectures on the basis of biblical texts.
Argue his/her position, showing that he/she is conscious of the complexity of the questions at stake, also when confronted with various philosophical and religious traditions.
Read a biblical text methodically, showing that he/she understands what is implied by such a process of reading and interpreting a text in the present context.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to biblical literature (Old and New Testament)
The strange character of the Bible as literature from a distant past
Reactions to the topic, with particular attention to the fundamentalist treatment of the Bible
Nuanced approach to biblical texts presupposing a basic knowledge of the Biblical sciences
bibliography: H. Ausloos & B. Lemmelijn, La Bible et la vie. Réponses bibliques aux questions d'aujourd'hui (Le livre et le rouleau, 48), Namur – Paris: Lessius, 2016.

H. Ausloos & B. Lemmelijn, The Book of Life. Biblical Answers to Existential Questions (Louvain Theological and Pastoral Monographs, 41), Louvain – Paris – Walpole, MA: Peeters; Grand Rapids, MI; Cambridge: William B. Eerdmans, 2010.
degree: Bachelor in Engineering (Bachelier en sciences de l'ingénieur, orientation ingénieur civil) - FSA1BA
